partnership_announcements.description: VEON completed an infrastructure partnership in Pakistan with Engro Corporation, transferring tower assets via Deodar into Engro Connect at an enterprise value of USD 562.7 million. Jazz will lease this infrastructure under a long-term agreement, supporting its digital services transition.

press_references.value: VEON and Engro Corporation Advance to Closing Pioneering Infrastructure Partnership in Pakistan Following Regulatory Approvals

partnership_announcements.description: VEON and Engro Corporation have secured all regulatory approvals and are advancing to close a strategic infrastructure partnership in Pakistan. The agreement involves pooling and managing telecommunications infrastructure assets, with VEON's assets under Deodar (Private) Limited vesting into Engro Connect, a subsidiary of Engro Corp. Engro will pay Jazz approximately USD 188 million and guarantee repayment of Deodar’s intercompany debt of USD 375 million. The partnership aims to enhance infrastructure efficiency and support Pakistan's digital transformation.

press_references.value: VEON And Airspan Sign MoU To Collaborate On Air-To-Land Network Solutions Supporting Ukraine's Resilience

partnership_announcements.description: VEON and Airspan have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to collaborate on air-to-land network solutions aimed at supporting Ukraine's resilience. This partnership involves VEON Ltd and Airspan Networks working together to enhance digital infrastructure in Ukraine.

For more information visit: www.veon.com

about_short_description.short_description: VEON (Nasdaq: VEON) is a digital operator that provides converged connectivity and digital services to nearly 160 million customers.

product.name: Mobile Connectivity Services
product.description: Mobile voice, messaging, mobile data, broadband and 4G connectivity services delivered through VEON’s operating brands across Pakistan, Ukraine, Bangladesh, Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan.

product.name: Digital Operator Platform
product.description: A portfolio of connectivity-enabled digital services spanning finance, entertainment, education, healthcare and other consumer services.

product.name: Digital Financial Services
product.description: Mobile financial services, including digital payments, neobanking and other services designed to provide access to financial products through mobile platforms.

product.name: Digital Entertainment Services
product.description: Mobile and online entertainment services providing video streaming, television content, music and other digital media through VEON’s local brands.

product.name: Simply
product.description: A digital banking and neobanking service operated by Beeline Kazakhstan for mobile-based access to financial services.

product.name: BeeTV
product.description: An over-the-top entertainment platform operated by Beeline Kazakhstan that provides digital video and television content to consumers.
